label: Freeform net
tooltip: Lay a quad net over the scan, automatically or by hand row by row; the deviation shows live as colour.
help: For roundings and organic shapes. Auto net lays the net over the scan or the selection in one step; by hand it grows face by face: place a face, then drag border edges. The status bar tells what the mouse does right now. OK creates B-spline faces, a body when the net is closed.

face.label: Place face
face.description: Click four corners on the scan, one after another.

all.label: Snap to scan
all.description: Lay the whole net onto the scan.

chosen.label: Snap chosen
chosen.description: Lay only the chosen points onto the scan.

all.label: Smooth
all.description: Calm the whole net; it stays close to the scan.

flatten.label: Lay on a plane
flatten.description: Lay the chosen points (at least 3) on their best-fit plane.

snap.label: Snap to scan
snap.description: Dragged points and new rows land on the scan.

legend: Green: within tolerance · Yellow to red: outside the scan · Blue: inside · Grey: far away
irregularHint: Red points: face borders start here. Fewer of them give larger CAD faces.

hints.start: Place face, then click four corners on the scan
hints.face: Click corner {{count}} of 4 on the scan · Backspace: back · Esc: cancel
hints.point: Drag: move · onto a border point: join · Alt: along the normal · Delete: remove
hints.border: Drag: new row · onto border points: join faces · Double click: whole side · S: insert a row
hints.edge: Click: choose · Double click: edge chain · Drag: move · S: insert a row · Delete: remove
hints.rows: Release: add the row · yellow points get joined · Esc: cancel
hints.idle: Drag a border edge: extend the net · Drag a point: shape · Rectangle: choose points
